Interface StorageGroup

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface StorageGroup extends AutoCloseable
Named directory of subgroups, datasets, and attributes.

API status: Stable.

Cross-language equivalents: Objective-C TTIOStorageGroup, Python ttio.providers.base.StorageGroup.

  • Method Details

    • name

      String name()
      Returns:
      the short (last-path-segment) name of this group; "/" for the root group.

    • childNames

      List<String> childNames()
      Returns:
      every child link name (sub-group or dataset) directly under this group in storage order.

    • hasChild

      boolean hasChild(String name)
      Parameters:
      name - the child link name
      Returns:
      true when a sub-group or dataset of that name exists directly under this group.

      the opened StorageGroup

    • createGroup

      StorageGroup createGroup(String name)
      Create a new sub-group.

    • deleteChild

      void deleteChild(String name)

      the opened StorageDataset

    • createDataset

      StorageDataset createDataset(String name, Enums.Precision precision, long length, int chunkSize, Enums.Compression compression, int compressionLevel)
      Create a primitive 1-D dataset.
      Parameters:
      name - the dataset name
      precision - the element type
      length - element count along the single axis
      chunkSize - chunk extent (honoured only when the backend reports StorageProvider.supportsChunking())
      compression - compression algorithm
      compressionLevel - algorithm-specific level (0 = none)
      Returns:
      the newly-created StorageDataset

    • createDatasetND

      default StorageDataset createDatasetND(String name, Enums.Precision precision, long[] shape, long[] chunks, Enums.Compression compression, int compressionLevel)
      Create a multi-dimensional dataset. 1-D delegates to createDataset(String, Enums.Precision, long, int, Enums.Compression, int); higher ranks require provider override.

    • createCompoundDataset

      StorageDataset createCompoundDataset(String name, List<CompoundField> fields, long count)
      Create a 1-D compound dataset.

      name - the dataset name
      fields - the ordered list of fields in one record
      count - number of records
      Returns:
      the newly-created StorageDataset
